name: ANSI block shading
summary: Drawing with the block and shade characters of the IBM PC character set, in 16 colours, on an 80 by 25 grid.
how: Draw on a grid of 80 columns by 25 rows, with cells of 8px by 16px.
Use ░ at 25%, ▒ at 50%, ▓ at 75% and █ at 100% to blend two colours.
Limit one cell to one foreground colour from 16 and one background colour from 8.
Add a signature in the lower right corner.

origin.note: MS-DOS 2.0 loaded ANSI.SYS, which let a text screen set colour and cursor position with escape codes.

adoptions.via: Users of dial-up bulletin boards draw logos and menus with block characters and ANSI colour codes.
